newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 10.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Washington Post page one - Dec 10.

text.p: The Washington Post carried the following stories on its front page on Dec. 10:

RICHMOND, VIRGINIA - Republican Gov. George Allen's administration has a dismal record in enforcing state and federal water quality laws and has protected corporate polluters, a legislative panel said.

WASHINGTON - Washington area residents waste 58 hours of time and 60 gallons of gasoline a year sitting in traffic, making the hidden cost of gridlock higher here than anywhere else in the nation, a federal study found.
BELGRADE - Opponents of the government of Serbian President Slobodan Milosevic come from manifold groups, including students, the once-prosperous middle class, and even some workers.
WASHINGTON - Television industry executives are likely to adopt next week a system that uses six broad categories to rate entertainment programs by age suitability.
BOSTON - The Edison Project, one of the most provocative ventures in American education, is trying to remake schools entirely with its own ideals, by casting aside old habits of public education.

MEXICO CITY - Hundreds of underfed, ragged children from the city's most wretched slums have occupied the streets, washing windshields, hawking candy and performing acrobatic tricks, scrambling for a few pesos.
